ocrMode.label: OCR language
ocrMode.english_description: Latin script. Best for English-only screens.
ocrMode.hindi_description: Devanagari script. Best for Hindi-only screens.
ocrMode.gujarati_description: Gujarati script, e.g. “તમારું ઓર્ડર સફળતાપૂર્વક મોકલી દેવામાં આવ્યું છે.”
ocrMode.mixed_description: Both scripts in one pass, e.g. “आपका Order Shipped हो गया”.
ocrMode.gujarati_english_description: Both scripts, e.g. “તમારો Order Successfully Shipped થઈ ગયો છે.”
ocrMode.hindi_gujarati_description: Picks the better reading line by line. Slower than a single language.
ocrMode.all_description: All three scripts. The slowest mode; use it only for truly mixed screens.
ocrMode.engineNote: English and Hindi use Google ML Kit; Gujarati uses Tesseract. Both run on your phone.

home.step2Title: Open any app and tap the button
home.step2Body: Browser, PDF, chats, shopping — whatever is on screen.
home.step3Body: The text is already on your clipboard.
home.emptyBody: Text you capture with the floating button will appear here.
home.historyOffBody: Captures are copied but not saved. Turn on history in Settings to keep them.

extracted.deleteConfirm: This extraction will be removed from your history.
extracted.clearConfirm: Clear all text in the editor? The saved extraction is unchanged until you save.

extracted.missingBody: It may have been deleted, or the app was restarted with history off.
extracted.speechFailed: Couldn't read aloud. Check Speech & voice in Settings.

settings.title: Settings
settings.signOutConfirm: You will need to sign in again to continue.
settings.ocrHint: Applies to your next capture. Independent of the text style.
settings.floatingEnabledHint: Shows over other apps while on
settings.resetPositionDone: The button will return to the right edge.
settings.floatingRestrictions: Android shows a notification while the button is on. Some apps (banking, DRM video, private tabs) block screen capture; their content stays unreadable by design.
settings.autoCopyHint: Put extracted text on the clipboard right away
settings.saveHistoryHint: Keep up to 50 recent extractions on this phone
settings.clearHistoryConfirm: Every saved extraction will be deleted from this phone. This can't be undone.
settings.privacyNote: Screenshots are processed in memory on your phone and discarded right after reading. Text is spoken by the text-to-speech engine on your phone. Only “Speak with translation” sends data off the phone — the extracted text, to Google Gemini, after you opt in.

appearance.previewBody: This is how text, buttons and cards will look.
appearance.typography_classic_description: Traditional serif, a more formal feel

about.title: Privacy & help
about.privacyBody: No account, no login, no Akshar servers. OCR runs entirely on your phone. Screenshots are held in memory only while they are read, then discarded. History, if on, stays on this phone. The only exception is “Speak with translation”: after you opt in, the extracted text (never the screenshot) is sent to the Google Gemini API with your own API key.
about.permOverlayWhy: Draws the floating capture button above other apps.
about.permCaptureWhy: Lets the app take one screenshot each time you tap the button. Android asks every time you turn the button on; you can share the entire screen or just one app.
about.permServiceWhy: Android requires it while screen sharing is active; it shows the ongoing notification with a Stop action.
about.permNotificationsWhy: Shows that ongoing notification on Android 13 and later.
about.tipBlank: Nothing is detected in an app: it may block screen capture (banking, DRM video, incognito tabs). This is enforced by Android.
about.tipStopped: The button disappeared: screen sharing ended (from the status bar, lock screen, or another app). Turn it on again from the home screen.
about.tipAccuracy: Poor results: pick the OCR language that matches the screen, zoom in on small text, and avoid blurred or animated content.
about.tipSingleApp: Only one app is readable: you chose “Share one app”. Turn the floating button off and on, and choose “Entire screen” to read any app.
about.tipBattery: The button does nothing in the background: some phones restrict background apps — allow this app to run unrestricted in battery settings.
about.permAccessibilityWhy: Optional, and only if you turn it on in Android settings: scrolls the page in “Speak with auto-scroll” and presses your pinned Next button in “Speak with pagination”. It reads, stores and sends nothing.
about.ttsBody: Speech uses your phone's own text-to-speech engine (Google Speech Services when installed). Offline voices run on the device; voices marked “Needs internet” are processed by the engine provider. No API keys or accounts are involved.
about.tipVoice: No sound or a wrong accent: install the voice for that language in Settings → Speech & voice → Install voice data.
about.permInternetWhy: Used only by “Speak with translation”, to reach the Google Gemini API after you opt in. No other feature uses the network.

onboarding.welcomeBody: Copy Hindi and English text from any screen with one tap. Everything stays on your phone.
onboarding.languageBody: You can change this any time in Settings.
onboarding.themeBody: Pick a colour theme and mode.
onboarding.permissionsBody: The floating button needs to appear over other apps. Notifications show when it is active.
onboarding.skipForNow: You can also do this later from the home screen.

devSettings.label: API base URL

action.label: Action on floating button click
action.copy_description: Extract the text and copy it to the clipboard.
action.speak_description: Extract the text and read it aloud, with a playback controller.
action.speak_scroll_description: Read long pages: speak, scroll to the next part when speech ends, continue.
action.speak_pagination_description: For PDFs and e-books: read the page, press the Next button you pinned, continue on the next page.

speech.preferGoogleHint: Used when installed; otherwise your phone's default engine
speech.googleMissing: Google Speech Services isn't installed — using {{engine}}.
speech.engineFailed: The text-to-speech engine couldn't start. Open its settings to check it is installed and enabled.
speech.voiceMissingBody: Install the {{language}} voice in your text-to-speech engine, then come back. The app will not substitute a voice for another language.
speech.noVoices: This engine exposes no selectable voices for this language.
speech.test_voice_missing: That voice isn't available. Install it in the text-to-speech settings.
speech.test_speech_failed: Speech failed. Check the text-to-speech engine.
speech.test_not_ready: The text-to-speech engine isn't ready yet. Try again in a moment.
speech.switchByScriptHint: Read Hindi sentences with a Hindi voice and Gujarati with a Gujarati voice, when installed
speech.stopOnLeaveHint: In the app: when you leave the text screen. Over other apps: when the screen turns off
speech.resumeAfterInterruptionHint: Continue after a call or another app's sound
speech.scriptWarning: Your OCR language includes {{scripts}}, which the selected voice can't pronounce. Install those voices or turn on “Switch voice by script”.
speech.mixedNote: Voices are per language. Mixed sentences are read by one voice; Hindi and Gujarati voices read embedded English words, the English voice cannot read Indic scripts.
speech.voicesHint: Tap a language to see its voices. Tap a voice to use it; ▶ only plays a sample.
speech.emptyVoices: Your text-to-speech engine has no {{language}} voice on this phone.
speech.emptyVoicesHint: Install voice data, then come back — the list updates automatically.
speech.defaultVoiceDescription: Lets the engine pick its usual {{language}} voice
speech.preview_busy: A reading session is speaking. Pause or stop it before previewing voices.
speech.preview_voice_missing: That voice is no longer available. Choose another voice.
speech.preview_not_installed: That voice isn’t downloaded. Install it in the text-to-speech settings, or choose a downloaded voice.
speech.preview_speech_failed: The sample couldn’t play. Check the text-to-speech engine.
speech.preview_not_ready: The text-to-speech engine isn’t ready yet. Try again in a moment.
speech.savedVoiceUnavailable: Your saved voice “{{name}}” isn’t available any more. Choose another voice below.

reading.autoScrollHint: After a section is read, scroll to the next part
reading.disclosure: An overlay can't scroll other apps. Android only allows it through an accessibility service that you turn on yourself: Settings → Accessibility → Installed apps → “Akshar auto-scroll”. It is used only to scroll the page being read aloud; it does not read, store or send screen content. Without it, the app asks you to scroll and continues when you tap ▶.
reading.notAllApps: Some apps don't expose scrollable content; a swipe is tried instead, and reading ends when no new text appears.
reading.maxNoNewText: Stop after screens with nothing new
reading.manualFallbackHint: Without auto-scroll: you scroll, then tap ▶ to continue

pagination.intro: Reads one page, presses your pinned Next Page button once, checks that the page changed, then reads the next page.
pagination.howTo: 1. Turn on the floating button. 2. Tap “Locate Next Page Button”. 3. Open your document app, drag the crosshair onto its Next button and tap Save.
pagination.exactClick: Exact button found — it is pressed directly.
pagination.pointClick: Pressed by tapping the pinned point.
pagination.problem_rotated: The screen was rotated since pinning. Reposition the button.
pagination.problem_resized: The screen size or navigation bar changed since pinning. Reposition the button.
pagination.problem_density_changed: Display size changed since pinning. Reposition the button.
pagination.problem_out_of_bounds: The pinned point is off screen. Reposition the button.
pagination.problem_not_identifiable: This button can’t be tracked as it moves. Pin it again with “Fixed position”.
pagination.clearConfirm: Speak with pagination will ask you to pin it again.
pagination.needsOverlay: Turn on the floating button first; the crosshair appears over your document app.
pagination.pickerShown: The crosshair is on screen. Switch to your document app, drag it onto the Next button and tap Save.
pagination.modes: “Fixed position” suits toolbars and bottom bars that stay put while the document scrolls. “Moves with page” finds the button again by its accessibility label before each press — only possible when the app exposes one. A pin never follows unpredictable layout changes; if the screen changes, the app stops and asks you to reposition instead of pressing the wrong spot.
pagination.verifyTimeout: Give up if the page doesn’t change after
pagination.permissionWhy: Pressing a button in another app needs Akshar’s accessibility service (Settings → Accessibility → Installed apps → Akshar page turner). It is used only to press the button you pinned and to scroll in auto-scroll mode.
pagination.controls: While reading: tap the bubble to pause or resume. The controller has Pause, Restart page, Next page now (Retry once / Skip page when stuck), Reposition and Stop. A failed page turn is never retried automatically.

translate.summaryNoKey: On · → {{target}} · add a Gemini key (General tab)
translate.intro: When Apply translation is on, the text recognised on your phone is translated with Google Gemini before it is copied or read aloud.
translate.privacy: When translation is on, the text recognised on screen (never the screenshot) and your instructions are sent to the Google Gemini API with your own key, under Google’s terms.
translate.voiceMissing: No {{language}} voice is installed, so the translation can’t be spoken. Install it under Speech & voice.
translate.applyHint: Copy and every read-aloud mode use the translation (of the refined text, if Refine text is on). Sends the extracted text to Google Gemini.
translate.needsKey: Translation needs a Gemini API key. Add it in Settings → General → Gemini AI.

refine.applyHint: Repairs OCR damage — broken or cut-off words, stray symbols — before the text is copied, translated or read aloud. Sends the extracted text to Google Gemini.
refine.summaryReady: On · runs before copy, translation and speech
refine.summaryNoKey: On · add a Gemini key (General tab)
refine.needsKey: Refinement needs a Gemini API key. Add it in Settings → General → Gemini AI (it also sets the model and thinking level).
refine.order: Order: scan → refine → translate (if on) → copy or speak.
refine.footer: Uses your own Gemini key. Only the recognised text is sent — never the screenshot.

audioShare.applyHint: Lets the Akshar Listen extension on your computer play Akshar’s voice — or all phone audio. Works on the same Wi-Fi; nothing goes through the internet.
audioShare.requestBody: Allow only if your computer shows {{fingerprint}}.
audioShare.idle: Connected — audio is sent while Akshar speaks and Chrome is playing
audioShare.paused: Chrome is paused — Akshar keeps speaking here
audioShare.error_no_wifi: Connect the phone to Wi-Fi (the same network as your computer).
audioShare.error_port_failed: Could not start sharing on this network. Turn it off and on to retry.
audioShare.error_unsupported: Audio sharing isn’t available on this device.
audioShare.howTo: On the computer: load the Akshar Listen extension (public/crome-extension, see its README), open it, enter the address above and click Connect.
audioShare.privacy: Only what you choose is shared — never the microphone or calls. Every new computer must be allowed here, and the connection is encrypted.
audioShare.addressHint: Enter this address in the Akshar Listen extension and click Connect, then tap Allow here when the request appears.
audioShare.sourceHint_device: Everything apps play — YouTube, browser, music, games — plus Akshar’s voice. Not phone or app calls, and not apps that block capture (often paid video/music apps). Needs the floating button on and Android 10 or later.
audioShare.device_needs_permission: Android needs the Microphone permission for capturing app audio. Nothing is recorded from the microphone.
audioShare.device_needs_bubble: Turn on the floating button — capturing app audio uses its screen-capture permission.
audioShare.device_unsupported: Capturing app audio needs Android 10 or later. Only Akshar’s voice can be shared.
audioShare.device_failed: Android didn’t allow capturing app audio. Turn the floating button off and on, then try again.
audioShare.device_idle: All phone audio is shared while Chrome is playing.
audioShare.permissionDenied: Permission not given — open Android Settings → Apps → Akshar → Permissions to allow Microphone.

gemini.apiKeyHint: Create one in Google AI Studio. Restrict it to the Generative Language API. It is stored encrypted on this phone and never shown again.
gemini.keySaveFailed: The key couldn’t be stored securely on this phone.
gemini.keyTooShort: That doesn’t look like an API key.
gemini.modelsHint: Filled in when you tap Test connection.
gemini.projectHint: For your reference. Requests are always billed and counted in the project that owns the API key — create the key in project {{project}} and usage lands there. The API keeps no chat history.
gemini.projectInvalid: A project number has digits only.
gemini.removeKeyConfirm: Speak with translation stops working until you add a key again.
gemini.security: An API key used from an app can be extracted by someone with access to the phone. For a public release, use a backend proxy or Firebase App Check, and restrict the key to this app in Google Cloud.
gemini.test_api_disabled: The Generative Language API isn’t enabled for this key’s Google Cloud project.
gemini.test_bad_response: Gemini answered in an unexpected format.
gemini.test_invalid_key: The key was rejected. Check that you pasted it correctly and that it isn’t restricted to other APIs.
gemini.test_model_not_found: This model isn’t available for your key. Pick one from the list below, or use gemini-flash-latest.
gemini.test_ok: Connected — Gemini translated a test phrase.
gemini.test_quota: Quota or rate limit reached for this key.
gemini.test_server: Gemini had a problem. Try again later.
gemini.thinkingHint: Low is quick and efficient — best for translation. Models without thinking levels ignore this.
gemini.summaryNoKey: No API key · used by Refine text and Translation
gemini.intro: One Google Gemini API key, model and thinking level for every AI feature in Akshar: Refine text and Translation (OCR tab), and any future ones. The key is stored encrypted on this phone.

files.title: File Management
files.intro: Store files in your own Google Drive and share them with a link — straight from your phone.
files.driveSubtitle: Where File Share stores your files
files.connectBody: Sign in with Google and the files you upload are saved in your own Google Drive, in a folder called {{folder}}.
files.point1: Akshar can only see files it uploads — not the rest of your Drive.
files.point2: Your files stay yours, even if you disconnect later.
files.point3: You can remove access at any time, here or in your Google account.
files.savedIn: Your uploads are saved in the {{folder}} folder of this Google Drive.
files.disconnectBody: Files you already uploaded stay in your Drive. Akshar loses access until you connect again.
files.connectFail_play_services: Google Play services is missing or out of date on this phone.
files.connectFail_setup_required: Google sign-in isn’t set up for this build of Akshar yet. The app must be registered in Google Cloud (package name and signing SHA-1, with the Drive API enabled).
files.connectFail_failed: Couldn’t sign in to Google. Try again.
files.shareSubtitle: Upload, organise and share files with a link
files.needsDrive: Connect Google Drive above to start uploading and sharing files.
files.descriptionPlaceholder: Description for the next upload (optional) — shows in Google Drive
files.emptyBody: Upload a file or create a folder to get started.
files.deleteBody: It moves to your Google Drive trash, where you can restore it for 30 days.
files.error_not_connected: Your Google Drive connection ended. Connect again above.
files.error_network: No internet connection. Check your network and try again.
files.error_permission: Akshar doesn’t have permission for Google Drive files on this account. Tap “Allow Drive access” and tick the Drive checkbox on Google’s screen.
files.error_not_found: That item no longer exists in your Drive. Refresh to update the list.
files.error_quota: Google Drive is out of storage or is limiting requests. Try again later.
files.error_unknown: Something went wrong with Google Drive. Try again.
files.privacy: Files go straight from your phone to your Google Drive — never through an Akshar server.
files.usingShared: Using the shared Google Drive set in Settings → File Management. Connect your own Google account to use your own Drive instead.
files.sharedHint: No shared Drive is set up. Connect your Google account, or add a shared Drive in Settings → File Management.
files.error_shared_auth: The shared Drive’s client or refresh token was rejected. Update them in Settings → File Management.
files.error_api_disabled: The Google Drive API is turned off for this app’s Google Cloud project. Enable “Google Drive API” in Google Cloud Console (APIs & Services → Library) for the project that holds the Android sign-in client, wait a minute, then tap Try again.
files.noPreview: No preview for this type of file. Open it in Google Drive to view it.
files.pdfFailed_too_large: This PDF is over 100 MB, so only its first page is shown. Open it in Google Drive to read it all.
files.pdfFailed_preview_failed: This PDF couldn’t be opened here, so only its first page is shown. Open it in Google Drive to read it all.
files.pdfFailed_unsupported: PDF pages need Android. Only the first page is shown.

driveCreds.intro: File Share uses this Google Drive when no personal Google account is connected — the same values as the share-chat server (GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN, GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID).
driveCreds.secretSaved: Saved (…{{hint}}). Leave blank to keep it.
driveCreds.saved: Saved. File Share now uses this Drive when no account is connected.
driveCreds.saveFailed: Not saved — check that every value is filled in and in the right format (client ID ends with .apps.googleusercontent.com).
driveCreds.testOk: Connected — the folder is reachable ({{count}} items).
driveCreds.removeBody: Akshar forgets saved values and stops using the default configuration. Files already in the Drive stay there.
driveCreds.security: Stored encrypted on this phone (Android Keystore). The secret and refresh token are never shown again or sent anywhere except Google. Anyone with this Drive’s refresh token can access its files — keep it private and rotate it if it leaks.
driveCreds.usingDefault: Using this build’s default configuration. Save your own values to replace it, or Remove to turn it off.
driveCreds.restored: Back to this build’s default configuration.
